text:
Maria (Product Marketing): Hey design — we need a set of benchmark visuals for next week's launch + webinar. Deliverables: hero graphic (1), three benchmark charts (PNG + SVG each), webinar slide template (16:9 Google Slides), and a one‑pager PDF. Brand compliant, accessible (alt text), and social/slide-optimized. Can you confirm capacity and ETA? Target final by Fri EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Anya (Design): Quick q — are the charts based on raw CSV or a curated metrics sheet? Also which models/variants should be highlighted?

Maria (Product Marketing): Use the canonical benchmark sheet I just uploaded (link below). Metrics to surface: throughput (tokens/sec), p95 latency (ms), cost/token. Focus models: redwood-large, rw-medium-quant, and a hosted comparator. Want clear delta bars and callouts for cost savings — no absolute claims without legal clearance.

Leo (Design Ops): For the slide template: 16:9, Google Slides + PPTX export. Include logo lockup (top-left), product color palette, and a modular chart slide with annotations. Provide export presets for LinkedIn hero (1200x628), Twitter/Meta feed (1200x1200), and slide cover (1920x1080). I'll also add a master with token spending callout components.

Jamal (Growth Ops): Small ask — can we have social-ready variants with the launch UTM (utm_source=benchmark_launch) baked into the links? Also need a landing page banner image size (1400x560) and a slide CTA that maps to the webinar registration form (form id: wb-2026-04). We'll route inbound leads to sales via the existing benchmark nurture flow.

Anya (Design): Timeline proposal — mockups by Wed 9am PT, review cycle Wed afternoon, final assets exported Fri EOD. Deliverable checklist I will post in the thread. Need the brand asset pack (fonts, logo SVGs) and access to the benchmark CSV.

Maria (Product Marketing): Uploaded: Figma file (https://figma.redwood/benchmark-launch), CSV: https://s3.redwood/benchmark-2026.csv, benchmark doc: https://docs.redwood/benchmarks/2026. Copy notes: highlight 'up to 2x lower cost per token' — legal to confirm exact phrasing. Also include two short captions for social.

legal-bot: Automated check — flagged language '2x lower cost' requires substantiation. Recommend using 'up to 2x' or include a footnote referencing methodology doc. Also ensure no direct mention of competitor names without approval.

Maria (Product Marketing): Okay — switching to 'up to 2x' in copy. Will attach methodology cit. Thanks @legal-bot.

Anya (Design): Plan: creating 3 chart concepts (grouped bar, waterfall for delta, and a compact sparkline trend) + hero with single stat highlight. Will include SVGs + PNGs and a slide master. Accessibility: will add alt text and simple colorblind-friendly palette. Tagging when mocks are in Figma.

Leo (Design Ops): Also add a 1-page template PDF one‑pager (A4 and letter) that sales can use. Include a small 'about methodology' box and a CTA. I'll schedule a micro-review with Brand at Thu 10am PT.

Maria (Product Marketing): Amazing — thanks everyone. Please @mention me when mocks are ready. I'll coordinate webinar copy and registration flow. :rocket:

Anya (Design): Will do. Starting now, ping if you see anything missing in the brief. :thumbsup:
